# CAN-IMPACT Data Preprocessing

This R package organizes raw CAN-IMPACT REDCap exports into
analysis-ready data tables and performs basic data quality control.

The package:

- Splits the raw REDCap export into separate data tables.
- Calculates participant ages and parses ETI start dates.
- Converts raw spirometry measurements to percent predicted.
- Performs data quality checks for missing or implausible values.
- Produces a QC log describing values that were flagged or modified.

## Installation

The package can be installed and updated directly from GitHub using
`remotes`:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("JoshD898/CAN-IMPACT")
```

## Example Usage

Once installed, the main function is `organize`:

``` r

CANIMPACT::organize(
  export_path = "path/to/redcap_export.csv",
  output_dir = "path/to/output_directory"
)
```

This will create:

- `organized.xlsx` — the processed data, with each data table in a
  separate worksheet.
- `qc_log.csv` — a log of data quality issues identified during
  preprocessing.

The processed data are also returned as a named list:

``` r

data <- CANIMPACT::organize(
  export_path = "path/to/redcap_export.csv",
  output_dir = "path/to/output"
)

data$demographics
data$visits
data$pex
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_ages()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/add_ages.md)
  : Add age columns
- [`add_eti_dates()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/add_eti_dates.md)
  : Add ETI start date and time from ETI to spirometry
- [`add_spirometry()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/add_spirometry.md)
  : Add spirometry percent predicted values
- [`flag_missing_data()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/flag_missing_data.md)
  : Flag missing data
- [`get_baseline_char()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_baseline_char.md)
  : Extract baseline characteristics data
- [`get_demographics()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_demographics.md)
  : Extract demographics data
- [`get_medications()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_medications.md)
  : Extract medication data
- [`get_pex()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_pex.md)
  : Extract pulmonary exacerbation data
- [`get_pregnancy()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_pregnancy.md)
  : Extract pregnancy data
- [`get_repeat_instances()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_repeat_instances.md)
  : Get repeat instance numbers
- [`get_side_effects()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_side_effects.md)
  : Extract side effect data
- [`get_visit_numbers()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_visit_numbers.md)
  : Get visit numbers
- [`get_visits()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/get_visits.md)
  : Extract visit data
- [`organize()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/organize.md)
  : Organize and quality-control REDCap export data
- [`qc_logger()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/qc_logger.md)
  : Create a QC logger
- [`recode_columns()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/recode_columns.md)
  : Recode coded values in a data frame
- [`remove_empty_rows()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/remove_empty_rows.md)
  : Remove empty rows
- [`remove_impossible_values()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/remove_impossible_values.md)
  : Remove impossible values
- [`run_data_qc()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/run_data_qc.md)
  : Run data QC checks
- [`run_spirometry_qc()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/run_spirometry_qc.md)
  : Flag high spirometry percent predicted values
- [`split_data()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/split_data.md)
  : Split REDCap export into organized data frames
- [`stack_visits()`](https://joshd898.github.io/CAN-IMPACT/reference/stack_visits.md)
  : Stack baseline and follow-up visit data into a single data frame
